body.x: GOYANG, Korea (AVING Special Report on 'KES 2006') -- <Visual News> Samsung presented ''SDC-K60'' a 6M CCD camera equipped with ISO 1,600, x3 optical zoom, and a 2.5-inch 230K LCD during KES 2006.
